issues.description: Method return type mismatch for Lecture.toString(): the problem statement (and the Java contract for Object.toString()) expects a toString() that returns String (see problem_statement.md lines 36-38 where a String-formatted example is shown). In the solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) the method is declared as 'public Object toString()' (signature at line 64), which is not the correct return type and will cause a compilation error because it does not correctly override Object.toString() (which returns String). The template file contains the TODO placeholder for toString() (template src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 10). This inconsistency will block students from compiling and running the provided solution and confuses the expected method signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution's method signature to return String: declare 'public String toString()' (keep the @Override annotation) and ensure the method body returns a String. This makes the method properly override java.lang.Object.toString(), matches the problem statement example, and resolves the compilation error.
